# Quiet Recipe Starter 1.0.1

A complete native RiceWM taskbar/menu/frame palette with no executable additions. Original MIT-licensed source and icon. `media/screen.webp` is an actual fresh native RiceWM capture after applying these exact recipe bytes on env.now on 2026-10-10. Apply and restoration were independently exercised with zero browser errors; preview, cancellation, restart and full security qualification remain incomplete. This is a development example, not an approved marketplace release.

Submit the immutable commit with this folder as source root and marketplace.json, build.json, media.json as contracts. Server checks and final operator approval are required.
